text: In September 2026, the technical decline rate for paying banks was 0.26%, compared to 0.21% in August 2026 and 0.41% in September 2025. There were 26.3 billion payments processed by paying banks this month, with 1 in 385 failing technically. Punjab & Sind Bank recorded the highest technical decline rate among paying banks at 1.86%. While 45 of 50 paying banks remained under the 1% target, IDBI Bank saw an unusual increase in its receiving technical decline rate to 1.35% from its usual 0.23%.
